name: pocket-id-workshop
title_zh: 扫码即建临时通行证，散场自动销毁的 workshop
tagline_zh: 参会者不用注册个人账号，扫码用通行密钥进 Vercel 团队；你只管开场部署，散场一条命令连身份带数据全部清空。
tagline_en: Attendees skip personal signups—scan, passkey in, join your Vercel team. Deploy once, tear down with one command.
desc_en: Stand up, connect, run, and tear down a disposable passkey identity provider (Pocket ID on Vercel) for a workshop. Use when someone wants workshop attendees to sign in with passkeys, needs attendees provisioned into a Vercel Enterprise team without personal signups, asks to "set up workshop auth", "deploy Pocket ID", "connect the workshop IdP to my Vercel team", "get the QR code for signups", "why
why_zh: 把「临时身份提供商」做成可编程的一次性资源：Pocket ID 跑在 Vercel 上。
why_en: Turns a disposable IdP into a programmable resource: Pocket ID on Vercel, attendees pre-provisioned into your enterprise team.
limit_zh: 只服务 Vercel Enterprise 团队，且参会者须用支持通行密钥的浏览器。
limit_en: Vercel Enterprise teams only; attendees need passkey-capable browsers. Not for permanent IdP needs—teardown is irreversible, no account recovery.
title_en: Disposable passkey IdP for workshops, auto-teardown
